_about: Real raw ConPTY output (Windows 11, PS 5.1 host) of Claude Code 2.1.302, Codex 0.153.4 and Antigravity CLI 1.4.2, at the size each was drawn (GitHub #36): tasks whose punctuation Codex and agy dropped as they were typed, a paste Codex counted without them, an idle Claude Code whose last answer quotes its own busy hint,, a box taller than the screen under a status line of four rows, Claude Code at rest with its shortcuts panel open under its box ("?" in its empty box), and agy at 80x12, whose box shows only the last six lines of a task of short lines. raw is what readOutput(terminalId, 1000) returned then, cut to the shortest end of it that draws the same screen; text is what was typed, or about to be. Personal strings are replaced by ones of equal length.
